name: Mukai Tomoki
source:
Main character of this story.

In the past, he had an accident on his way to see the Far Fireworks and lost a friend he was with.

He entered Junior High School with a feeling of loss due to it, and was practically forced to join the Kotonoha Circle by Utano Shinonome.

He likes reading and astronomical observations.

He has a discreet personality, making him stop and overthink about everything. However, Tomoki himself hates this exact nature of not taking the chance to take a step forward.

[Edited From the [url=https://en.u-ena.com/character]official site[/url]]
